detailed_description:

Madison lowers into a crouch beside the railing and reaches toward Ava's gripping hand. She begins removing Ava's fingers SEQUENTIALLY and visibly, not all at once. Each release is physically understandable: one finger is pried away from the wet metal, Ava tightens the remaining fingers, then Madison moves to the next.

As Madison starts the deliberate finger-removal, Ava shouts, <d>[Chinese] 你干什么？！</d>

Madison, frightened and desperate rather than smiling or triumphant, answers, <d>[Chinese] 我只是想活。</d>

Continue the same action after the line. Do not add pushes, slaps, grabs to Ava's body, climbing, or unnecessary choreography. Ava stays outside the rail.

End with only the final minimal grip / final finger still maintaining contact with the railing. Ava has NOT yet fully released and has NOT yet begun the main fall. The next shot completes the release.
